about: HR210P-16T2MS-200 is a member of the HRUI 210P 2.5G Uplink Gigabit Web-Managed PoE Switch series. It is a Layer 2 Web Managed Gigabit PoE Switch designed for SMB, enterprise and IP surveillance networks. Featuring 16 Gigabit PoE+ ports, dual 2.5G SFP uplinks and a 185W PoE budget, it delivers reliable power and high-speed connectivity for IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones and other PoE devices. Advanced Layer 2 management including VLAN, QoS, LACP, STP/RSTP/MSTP, IGMP Snooping and PoE Watchdog ensures stable and efficient network operation.
